 ZIFA confirms fixture and ticketing details for Warriors’ home leg against Equatorial Guinea
 6:28 am 14/11/2026 13/11/2026 
 by Soccer24 Team 
 The Zimbabwe Football Association (ZIFA) has confirmed the fixture and ticketing details for the Warriors’ home AFCON 2027 qualifier against Equatorial Guinea.
 The match will be played on Sunday, 16 November, at the National Sports Stadium in Harare, with kick-off scheduled for 3pm.
 ZIFA has set ticket prices at US$20 for the Rest of the Ground (ROG) and US$100 for VIP.
 Supporters can purchase their tickets online through the association’s ticketing platform at tickets.zifa.co.zw.
 The fixture will be Zimbabwe’s second meeting with Equatorial Guinea in the November international window, following Thursday’s away goalless draw in Cameroon.
